canonical_statement: Non-human intelligences exist that possess superior knowledge and power relative to the human race.

attributions.surface_quote: a being of a kind superior to any of the human race

canonical_statement: Entities can act as messengers or ministers for forces that govern current terrestrial reality.

attributions.surface_quote: messenger from the forces ruling this earth at present

canonical_statement: Metaphysical truth can be encoded within linguistic structures to manifest as objective, verifiable proof.

attributions.surface_quote: proof of his claim exists in the manuscript itself

canonical_statement: The universe is composed of infinite possibility and the individual points of experience that interact with those possibilities.

attributions.surface_quote: The elements are Nuit— Space— that is, the total of possibilities... and Hadit, any point.

canonical_statement: Events are defined as the union of a monad with a specific experience.

attributions.surface_quote: Every event is a uniting of some one monad with one of the experiences.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is an aggregate of experiences that remains in constant flux.

attributions.surface_quote: Every man and every woman is a star, that is, an aggregate of such experiences.

canonical_statement: Subjective universes converge into a singular objective reality only when consciousness expands to encompass all possible experiences.

attributions.surface_quote: It is the same universe for each one as soon as it includes all possible experience.

canonical_statement: Direct knowledge of external objects is impossible; all perception is limited to internal mental impressions.

attributions.surface_quote: Neither of us can know anything of him at all beyond the total impression.

canonical_statement: The fundamental law of existence is the alignment of individual volition with one's inherent nature.

attributions.surface_quote: Love is the law, love under will.

canonical_statement: Every individual entity functions as an autonomous celestial body following a predetermined trajectory defined by past experience and inherent growth.

attributions.surface_quote: Each of us stars is to move on our true orbit.

canonical_statement: All occurrences in the universe are lawful and necessary, though only one specific action is appropriate for an individual at any given moment.

attributions.surface_quote: All events are equally lawful—and every one necessary.

canonical_statement: Action is defined as the unification of the individual with the infinite totality of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Each action or motion is an act of love, the uniting with one or another part of Nuit.

canonical_statement: Will and Love are ontologically equivalent forces within the structure of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: Thelema is the Greek for Will, and has the same numerical value as Agape.

canonical_statement: Cosmic cycles are governed by distinct entities or aggregates of experience acting as planetary stewards.

attributions.surface_quote: certain vast “stars” (or aggregates of experience) may be described as Gods.

canonical_statement: Human societal and existential paradigms shift according to the influence of successive cosmic archetypes.

attributions.surface_quote: Isis, Osiris, Horus... in charge of the destinies of this planet for periods of 2,000 years.

canonical_statement: Individual identity is the fundamental unit of social and existential reality in the current epoch.

attributions.surface_quote: This present period involves the recognition of the individual as the unit of society.

canonical_statement: All events, including death, are voluntary accretions of experience that are simultaneously predestined.

attributions.surface_quote: Every event, including death, is only one more accretion to our experience, freely willed.

canonical_statement: The historical progression of humanity is divided into distinct temporal cycles known as Aeons.

attributions.surface_quote: The moment of change from one period to another is called The Equinox of the Gods.

canonical_statement: Humanity currently exists in a state of spiritual immaturity, characterized as a collective childhood.

attributions.surface_quote: We are children.

canonical_statement: The evolution of consciousness is driven by the actions of individuals who anticipate and adapt to shifting temporal trends.

attributions.surface_quote: The abnormal man who foresees the trend of the times... is a survivor.

canonical_statement: Political and social movements are manifestations of the developmental stages of a new cosmic era.

attributions.surface_quote: They are abortive births of the Child, the New Aeon of Horus.

canonical_statement: Human progress is driven exclusively by the creative output of individual genius.

attributions.surface_quote: the world only moves by the light of genius.

canonical_statement: The optimal structure of society is one where state governance is derived from the absolute liberty of the individual will.

attributions.surface_quote: The absolute rule of the state shall be a function of the absolute liberty of each individual will.

canonical_statement: The collective or 'herd' mentality is inherently destructive and leads to the annihilation of the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: The herd will be destroyed in mass.

canonical_statement: Every individual human being possesses the ontological status of a star, implying inherent divinity and autonomy.

attributions.surface_quote: Every man and every woman is a star.

canonical_statement: All numerical values possess the property of infinity, rendering quantitative distinctions illusory.

attributions.surface_quote: Every number is infinite; there is no difference.

canonical_statement: The essential self (Khabs) contains the luminous body or manifestation (Khu), rather than the reverse.

attributions.surface_quote: The Khabs is in the Khu, not the Khu in the Khabs.

canonical_statement: The core of individual consciousness acts as a secret, central point of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Be thou Hadit, my secret centre.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is an infinite, all-encompassing space that permeates all individual beings.

attributions.surface_quote: I am above you and in you.

canonical_statement: Existence is characterized by an unbroken, continuous nature rather than discrete, fragmented states.

attributions.surface_quote: the consciousness of the continuity of existence

canonical_statement: The perception of difference or separation between entities is a source of suffering and limitation.

attributions.surface_quote: Let there be no difference made among you between any one thing & any other thing; for thereby there cometh hurt.

canonical_statement: The divine is not an external deity but is identical to the totality of infinite space and the stars.

attributions.surface_quote: I am Infinite Space, and the Infinite Stars thereof

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is defined by the interaction between infinite space and the infinitesimal point of consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: She bends in ecstasy to kiss the secret ardours of Hadit.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of the infinite is non-dual and continuous, transcending numerical categorization.

attributions.surface_quote: speak not of Thee as One but as None

canonical_statement: The manifestation of the universe arises from the division of the infinite to facilitate the experience of union.

attributions.surface_quote: I am divided for love's sake, for the chance of union.

canonical_statement: The fundamental purpose of existence is the dissolution of the individual back into the infinite.

attributions.surface_quote: the joy of dissolution all

canonical_statement: The fundamental law of existence is the exercise of individual will, while restriction is the only true transgression.

attributions.surface_quote: Do what thou wilt shall be the whole of the Law. The word of Sin is Restriction.

canonical_statement: Love is the only valid mechanism for uniting the divided aspects of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: There is no bond that can unite the divided but love

canonical_statement: The highest form of volition is devoid of attachment to specific outcomes or teleological purpose.

attributions.surface_quote: Pure will, unassuaged of purpose, delivered from the lust of result, is every way perfect.

canonical_statement: Ultimate reality is a non-dual state that transcends the distinction between the perfect and the manifest.

attributions.surface_quote: The Perfect and the Perfect are one Perfect and not two; nay, are none!

canonical_statement: The universe is structured as a hierarchy of distinct systems that must remain isolated from one another.

attributions.surface_quote: Thus ye have star & star, system & system; let not one know well the other!

canonical_statement: All religious and philosophical systems are partial truths that fail to resolve the complete equation of existence.

attributions.surface_quote: All words are sacred and all prophets true; save only that they understand a little.

canonical_statement: The fundamental law governing existence is the integration of love with individual will.

attributions.surface_quote: Love is the law, love under will.

canonical_statement: The divine entity represents the totality of sensory pleasure and the innermost experience of consciousness.

attributions.surface_quote: I who am all pleasure and purple, and drunkenness of the innermost sense.

canonical_statement: Human beings possess an inherent, latent spiritual power that can be awakened.

attributions.surface_quote: Arouse the coiled splendour within you.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of being is achieved through the union of the individual with the divine, requiring the total surrender of the ego.

attributions.surface_quote: Whoso gives one particle of dust shall lose all in that hour.

canonical_statement: Perception of divine reality is dependent upon the spiritual capacity of the observer.

attributions.surface_quote: My colour is black to the blind, but the blue & gold are seen of the seeing.

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality consists of two complementary principles: an infinite, non-localized circumference and a dimensionless, omnipresent center.

attributions.surface_quote: I, Hadit, am the complement of Nu... I am everywhere the centre.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness is the fundamental, non-extended point of existence present within all beings and celestial bodies.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the flame that burns in every heart of man, and in the core of every star.

canonical_statement: The subject and the object of worship are identical, as the divine essence is the actor behind all experience.

attributions.surface_quote: Who worshipped Heru-pa-kraath have worshipped me; ill, for I am the worshipper.

canonical_statement: Existence is inherently joyful, while suffering is a transient, illusory phenomenon.

attributions.surface_quote: existence is pure joy; that all the sorrows are but as shadows.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of the divine is non-existence or 'Nothingness' which transcends conventional numerical and archetypal categorization.

attributions.surface_quote: For I am perfect, being Not... I am none indeed.

canonical_statement: The knower and the known are fundamentally unified, rendering the act of seeking external divinity redundant.

attributions.surface_quote: thou wast the knower, and me.

canonical_statement: Individual consciousness is inherently immortal and persists beyond the dissolution of the physical body.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou shalt not die, but live. If the body of the King dissolve, he shall remain.

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of reality is non-dual, where the individual essence and the cosmic totality are unified.

attributions.surface_quote: If I lift up my head, I and my Nuit are one.

canonical_statement: Rational analysis and causal inquiry are illusory frameworks that impede the exercise of pure Will.

attributions.surface_quote: Reason is a lie; for there is a factor infinite & unknown.

canonical_statement: The exercise of Will is rendered ineffective when subjected to the constraints of logical justification.

attributions.surface_quote: If Will stops and cries Why, invoking Because, then Will stops & does nought.

canonical_statement: The divine essence is immanent within the individual rather than an external deity.

attributions.surface_quote: I am alone: there is no God where I am.

canonical_statement: Death is not a state of dread but a process of dissolution into eternal ecstasy.

attributions.surface_quote: there is no dread hereafter. There is the dissolution, and eternal ecstasy

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality is characterized by a state of non-dual union with the infinite.

attributions.surface_quote: eternal ecstasy in the kisses of Nu.

canonical_statement: The divine presence is incompatible with the existence of fear, failure, or sorrow.

attributions.surface_quote: Where I am these are not.

canonical_statement: The perceived separation between the individual and the divine is an illusory veil.

attributions.surface_quote: There is a veil... Tear down that lying spectre of the centuries

canonical_statement: The ultimate source of existence contains a hidden, invisible fifth principle.

attributions.surface_quote: there is a fifth who is invisible, & therein am I as a babe

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of an individual's spiritual state is immutable and persistent.

attributions.surface_quote: He that is righteous shall be righteous still; he that is filthy shall be filthy still.

canonical_statement: The apparent social and ontological hierarchy of the world is fixed and unchanging.

attributions.surface_quote: There is none that shall be cast down or lifted up: all is ever as it was.

canonical_statement: The true essence of an individual can be concealed behind an external persona.

attributions.surface_quote: it may be that yonder beggar is a King. A King may choose his garment as he will

canonical_statement: The ultimate reality of consciousness is a state of non-dual unity and void.

attributions.surface_quote: We are one; we are none.

canonical_statement: Death is a transformative experience that serves as a confirmation of spiritual union.

attributions.surface_quote: Thy death shall be the seal of the promise of our age long love.

canonical_statement: The capacity to experience joy is limited by the individual's current strength and refinement.

attributions.surface_quote: Be strong! Then canst thou bear more joy.

canonical_statement: Death is the ultimate fulfillment or culmination of the individual's existence.

attributions.surface_quote: death is the crown of all.

canonical_statement: The intensity of a desire for death directly correlates to the spiritual glory attained by the individual.

attributions.surface_quote: The length of thy longing shall be the strength of its glory.

canonical_statement: The individual identity is capable of transcending the scale of the cosmos.

attributions.surface_quote: thy stature shall surpass the stars.

canonical_statement: Certain metaphysical truths are encoded in ciphers that remain inaccessible to the current prophet.

attributions.surface_quote: Thou knowest not; nor shalt thou know ever.

canonical_statement: The fundamental nature of reality is characterized by an underlying unity that transcends apparent division.

attributions.surface_quote: There is division hither homeward; all is not aught.

canonical_statement: The divine entity manifests as an active force of conflict and retribution within the phenomenal world.

attributions.surface_quote: I am a god of War and of Vengeance.

canonical_statement: The individual must establish a protected, sovereign space for the cultivation of spiritual or metaphysical work.

attributions.surface_quote: Choose ye an island! Fortify it!

canonical_statement: The principle of causality is an illusion or a transient state that has ceased to exist.

attributions.surface_quote: Because of the fall of Because, that he is not there again.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness finds refuge in the infinite space of the universe and illumination in the infinitesimal point of the self.

attributions.surface_quote: Nu is your refuge as Hadit your light.

canonical_statement: The divine force acts as the inherent strength and vigor within the individual's physical actions.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the strength, force, vigour, of your arms.

canonical_statement: The individual identity is the central focus of worship and the unifying point for all other manifestations of reality.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the visible object of worship; the others are secret.

canonical_statement: Physical objects and ritual substances can be imbued with metaphysical force through specific preparation and intent.

attributions.surface_quote: be they long kept, it is better; for they swell with my force.

canonical_statement: A sacred space possesses an invisible, indestructible structure that persists independently of its physical manifestation.

attributions.surface_quote: though with fire and sword it be burnt down... an invisible house there standeth.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of divine authority and prophetic truth is cyclical and subject to temporal epochs.

attributions.surface_quote: another prophet shall arise... another king shall reign.

canonical_statement: The individual consciousness (Khabs) possesses an inherent capacity to influence or stabilize the self.

attributions.surface_quote: The ways of the Khabs run through / To stir me or still me!

canonical_statement: Divine light functions as an internal force that empowers the individual to manifest cosmic order.

attributions.surface_quote: its red flame is as a sword in my hand to push thy order.

canonical_statement: The human soul contains a hidden access point to the divine or transcendent realms.

attributions.surface_quote: I have made a secret door / Into the House of Ra

canonical_statement: The individual is a vessel for divine presence, which acts as an internal catalyst for creative or spiritual work.

attributions.surface_quote: Hadit burning in thy heart shall make swift and secure thy pen.

canonical_statement: Success in worldly or spiritual endeavors serves as the primary empirical validation of one's alignment with divine will.

attributions.surface_quote: Success is thy proof

canonical_statement: The structure of reality is encoded within the specific arrangement and visual form of linguistic characters.

attributions.surface_quote: in the chance shape of the letters and their position to one another: in these are mysteries

canonical_statement: The ultimate nature of the divine is a secret, fourfold word that functions as a negation of all existing human religious constructs.

attributions.surface_quote: I am in a secret fourfold word, the blasphemy against all gods of men.

canonical_statement: The attainment of spiritual power requires the total rejection of compassion, pity, and traditional moral constraints.

attributions.surface_quote: Let her work the work of wickedness! Let her kill her heart!

canonical_statement: The fundamental law of existence is the exercise of individual volition.

attributions.surface_quote: There is no law beyond Do what thou wilt.

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution is achieved through successive stages of ordeal and transformation.

attributions.surface_quote: Come ye through tribulation of ordeal, which is bliss.

canonical_statement: The ultimate state of the universe is void or non-existence following the dissolution of manifested reality.

attributions.surface_quote: I have crushed an Universe; & nought remains.

canonical_statement: Love is the governing principle of action when directed by individual will.

attributions.surface_quote: Love is the law, love under will.

canonical_statement: The nature of the divine is characterized by silence, strength, and the capacity for universal destruction.

attributions.surface_quote: I am the Hawk-Headed Lord of Silence & of Strength.
